summary: Nayax Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on May 19, 2026. The filing incorporates by reference its proxy statement from March 19, 2026 and supplemental proxy from May 11, 2026, noting that all proposals except withdrawn Proposal 11 were approved. This is a routine meeting results report with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The registrant is the issuer filing a standard outcome-of-meeting notice.
